units: <cite ref="Yoma 84b:10">Yoma 84ᵇ</cite> <he>ומְכַּשְׁכֵּישׁ ליה באמגוזי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>משביש</he>, Var. in Ar. s. v. <he>שבש</he>: <he>מְקַשְׁקֵישׁ</he>) he may rattle nuts for it (to entertain the child).
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:8">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>לכַשְׁכּוּשֵׁי בקי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לכַרְכּוּשֵׁי</he>) to chase off gnats by striking (with the tail).
